points: This carryover audit supplements only G2 and G3; G0/G4/G5/G1 are inherited from the captured record.

A real Chrome session read the complete first two US-English result pages without CAPTCHA. Page one has one exact Google guide and release note, a product overview, three general VPC Service Controls videos, an InfoQ implementation and generic guidance; page two drops into broad networking, Vertex AI, Terraform, tutorials and unrelated perimeter setup.
G2=pass: despite a video block, the SERP has no exact-task video or strong-brand takeover; the second page establishes a clear recommender-specific quality cliff.

Google's exact Preview guide is a complete implementation: it explains risk insights, roles, daily refresh limits, console/CLI/API access, and gcloud fixes for unconfigured or misconfigured VPC accessible services. It reports Last updated 2026-08-13 UTC.

G3=pass: no second free page completes the exact VPC Service Controls recommender workflow. The videos and third-party pages cover general perimeters or exfiltration rather than retrieving and applying these recommendations.
This is not veto_window_bet because no second already-built exact implementation is merely awaiting indexing.

Window estimate is weeks, expiring 2026-09-20. The feature is Preview and the exact official guide and release note are only seven days old, while broad VPC Service Controls content creates nearby semantic competition.

Invalidation conditions: two free end-to-end recommender optimization guides enter the SERP; Google publishes a second official tutorial or codelab; Preview status, recommendation types, Recommender API behavior, or gcloud remediation commands change.
